summary: The completed 12:00 UTC BTC interval produced a second independently corroborated range-only volatility burst after the prior 09:00 burst normalized by 11:00. Bybit spot range robust z was +3.95 while spot-volume robust z was only +0.85; no abnormal-turnover, directional order-flow, persistent-liquidity, or causal cross-market claim is supported.
surface: ARGUS authenticated volatility versus order-flow classification
NEXUS representation reconciliation and event-time integrity

evidence.note: Linear reported volume is representation-specific and was not fused with spot BTC volume.
Point-in-time snapshot only; no historical depth baseline.

evidence.finding: The 09:00 burst, 11:00 normalization, and new 12:00 burst strengthen a recurrent episodic range-expansion interpretation. Lack of abnormal spot volume prevents escalation to an abnormal-flow or joint range-plus-turnover event.

data_gaps: No historical depth or trade sequence was acquired; order-flow direction, persistent liquidity, auction behavior, liquidations, funding, basis, open interest and exchange flow are unknown.
No fresh direct NQ/MNQ, GC/MGC, SI, DXY, Treasury/rate or volatility-index observation was acquired in this bounded cycle.
Provider-specific retrieval timestamps were unavailable for K-line/time-series responses; the parallel batch's Bybit orderbook server timestamp anchors retrieval.
regime_implication: Recurrent intraday BTC range bursts are appearing after rapid normalization, consistent with episodic volatility clustering rather than continuously elevated volatility. No trading or routing behavior was changed.
next_decisive_check: Test whether the next completed BTC hour normalizes again or develops joint range-plus-turnover expansion, and acquire synchronous direct futures/USD/rates/volatility data to determine whether the burst is BTC-specific or cross-market.

argus.finding: Authenticated Bybit spot candles show a +3.95 robust-z range burst with only +0.85 volume robust-z; classify as volatility evidence, not authenticated abnormal order flow. Current displayed depth is a single snapshot only.

nexus.finding: The 12:00 ranges reconcile tightly across Bybit spot ($293.80), Bybit linear ($302.20), and Twelve Data ($291.81); the forming 13:00 interval was excluded and representation-specific volumes were not fused.
